tagline: Formal code inspection, automated by AI
one_sentence_purpose: A Claude Code and Codex CLI skill that runs formal Fagan Inspections on code changes, producing structured defect reports with severity ratings and fix recommendations.
target_users: Software engineers and teams using AI coding assistants who want rigorous, structured code review beyond basic linting
visual_metaphors: a magnifying glass over structured code blocks revealing hidden defects
inspection checklist with checkmarks flowing through review phases
a prism splitting code into domain review channels
